captions: [{"start":0.03,"end":2.87,"text":"In 2025, the world moved more goods and"},{"start":2.93,"end":5.44,"text":"services than ever before about $35"},{"start":5.44,"end":9.26,"text":"trillion worth, a jump of roughly 7.5%."},{"start":9.29,"end":10.78,"text":"That is the surprise."},{"start":10.81,"end":12.42,"text":"Trade is not shrinking."},{"start":12.45,"end":14.34,"text":"It is growing at record speed."},{"start":14.37,"end":16.9,"text":"Containers are fuller, ports are busier,"},{"start":16.93,"end":18.9,"text":"and the value crossing borders is larger"},{"start":18.93,"end":20.64,"text":"than any year in history."},{"start":20.67,"end":21.85,"text":"So why does it feel like the trading"},{"start":22.17,"end":23.82,"text":"system is falling apart?"},{"start":23.85,"end":25.76,"text":"Because volume and trust are moving in"},{"start":25.76,"end":26.9,"text":"opposite directions."},{"start":26.93,"end":28.7,"text":"The same year that set the trade record"},{"start":28.77,"end":31.22,"text":"also produced new tariffs, new export"},{"start":31.22,"end":33.47,"text":"controls, and a quiet retreat from the"},{"start":33.47,"end":35.42,"text":"rules that made global trade predictable"},{"start":35.42,"end":36.89,"text":"in the first place."},{"start":36.93,"end":38.78,"text":"That is the paradox we are going to"},{"start":38.78,"end":41.2,"text":"unpack, more trade, less trust."},{"start":41.25,"end":43.44,"text":"How can both be true at the same time?"},{"start":43.47,"end":45.42,"text":"Start with the record itself."},{"start":45.45,"end":48.14,"text":"The United Nations Trade Agency, UNCTAD,"},{"start":48.17,"end":50.12,"text":"estimates that world trade in goods and"},{"start":50.12,"end":54.06,"text":"services grew by about 7.5% in 2025,"},{"start":54.06,"end":56.85,"text":"reaching roughly $35 trillion."},{"start":56.89,"end":59.73,"text":"Manufacturing, especially electronics, did"},{"start":59.76,"end":61.34,"text":"most of the heavy lifting."},{"start":61.37,"end":63.66,"text":"Energy and cars lagged behind."},{"start":63.69,"end":65.2,"text":"But here is the second half of the"},{"start":65.2,"end":67.43,"text":"sentence, the one that usually gets left"},{"start":67.43,"end":67.92,"text":"out."},{"start":67.95,"end":70.27,"text":"The same agency warns that the outlook is"},{"start":70.27,"end":72.06,"text":"increasingly fragile."},{"start":72.09,"end":74.54,"text":"Growth is expected to slow sharply in"},{"start":74.54,"end":75.78,"text":"2026."},{"start":75.81,"end":77.74,"text":"The World Trade Organization projects"},{"start":77.74,"end":79.92,"text":"goods trade growth of under 2%, so the"},{"start":80.23,"end":82.31,"text":"record year is not a sign that all is"},{"start":82.31,"end":82.86,"text":"well."},{"start":82.89,"end":85.02,"text":"It is the last surge before the weather"},{"start":85.02,"end":85.72,"text":"changes."},{"start":85.81,"end":87.49,"text":"That brings us to the rule that made this"},{"start":87.49,"end":89.85,"text":"system work, a phrase worth knowing, most"},{"start":89.85,"end":91.44,"text":"favored nation treatment."},{"start":91.53,"end":94.14,"text":"It sounds grand, but the idea is simple."},{"start":94.17,"end":96.08,"text":"When a country gives one trading partner"},{"start":96.08,"end":98.33,"text":"its best tariff rate, it must give the"},{"start":98.43,"end":99.82,"text":"same rate to everyone."},{"start":99.85,"end":101.98,"text":"No favorites, one price for all."},{"start":102.01,"end":103.76,"text":"That single promise is what kept the"},{"start":103.76,"end":106.04,"text":"global system from collapsing into a web"},{"start":106.04,"end":107.24,"text":"of private deals."},{"start":107.29,"end":109.58,"text":"The WTO says the share of world trade"},{"start":109.58,"end":111.19,"text":"actually conducted on those most favored"},{"start":111.51,"end":114.52,"text":"nation terms has fallen to about 72%, and"},{"start":114.52,"end":116.1,"text":"is still declining."},{"start":116.13,"end":117.32,"text":"That number matters."},{"start":117.53,"end":119.53,"text":"It means roughly a quarter of global trade"},{"start":119.57,"end":122.02,"text":"is now happening outside the old rulebook,"},{"start":122.05,"end":124.82,"text":"under regional deals, special exemptions,"},{"start":124.82,"end":127.27,"text":"tariffs aimed at specific countries, or no"},{"start":127.27,"end":128.41,"text":"clear rule at all."},{"start":128.45,"end":130.8,"text":"Now here is where the paradox sharpens."},{"start":130.89,"end":133.16,"text":"If trust is falling, why is volume still"},{"start":133.16,"end":133.94,"text":"rising?"},{"start":133.97,"end":135.89,"text":"The short answer, because the world is not"},{"start":135.89,"end":136.59,"text":"decoupling."},{"start":136.69,"end":137.87,"text":"It is rerouting."},{"start":137.93,"end":139.61,"text":"Think of the trade map as a highway"},{"start":139.61,"end":140.2,"text":"system."},{"start":140.23,"end":141.9,"text":"The roads are not disappearing."},{"start":141.93,"end":143.12,"text":"They are being redrawn."},{"start":143.37,"end":145.5,"text":"Cars are taking different exits."},{"start":145.53,"end":147.88,"text":"The clearest example is North America."},{"start":147.97,"end":150.22,"text":"For decades, China was the United States"},{"start":150.22,"end":152.06,"text":"largest trading partner."},{"start":152.09,"end":154.7,"text":"In 2026, Mexico overtook it."},{"start":154.73,"end":156.97,"text":"Mexico's exports to the United States now"},{"start":157.04,"end":161.26,"text":"top those from China, about $475 billion"},{"start":161.29,"end":164.82,"text":"versus roughly $427 billion."},{"start":164.85,"end":166.7,"text":"That is not a small story."},{"start":166.73,"end":168.73,"text":"It is the largest reordering of American"},{"start":168.8,"end":171.07,"text":"trade relationships in a generation."},{"start":171.33,"end":173.73,"text":"It is being driven partly by tariffs and"},{"start":173.76,"end":176.02,"text":"partly by companies choosing partners."},{"start":176.05,"end":178.4,"text":"They trust more than the cheapest option."},{"start":178.49,"end":180.66,"text":"The same pattern shows up across the map."},{"start":180.69,"end":183.46,"text":"Vietnam is pulling in more manufacturing."},{"start":183.49,"end":185.94,"text":"India is becoming an alternative assembly"},{"start":185.94,"end":186.46,"text":"base."},{"start":186.49,"end":188.61,"text":"Taiwan's chip industry is being asked to"},{"start":188.61,"end":190.49,"text":"prove where its products go."},{"start":190.63,"end":192.98,"text":"Export controls on advanced semiconductors"},{"start":193.05,"end":195.25,"text":"are rewriting which chips can cross which"},{"start":195.25,"end":195.88,"text":"borders."},{"start":195.93,"end":198.28,"text":"The old question was, where is it cheapest"},{"start":198.34,"end":199.01,"text":"to build?"},{"start":199.05,"end":201.2,"text":"The new question is, who is it safe to"},{"start":201.2,"end":202.1,"text":"build with?"},{"start":202.13,"end":204.13,"text":"That shift has a price, and markets are"},{"start":204.13,"end":205.14,"text":"starting to price it."},{"start":205.17,"end":207.06,"text":"Companies now say they are willing to pay"},{"start":207.06,"end":210.15,"text":"10% to 25% more for supply chains built on"},{"start":210.15,"end":212.56,"text":"trust rather than on pure cost."},{"start":212.61,"end":214.9,"text":"That premium is not an abstraction."},{"start":214.93,"end":217.17,"text":"It shows up in inventories, in factory"},{"start":217.17,"end":220.07,"text":"locations, in margins, and eventually in"},{"start":220.07,"end":221.84,"text":"the prices consumers pay."},{"start":221.89,"end":224.09,"text":"This is why the trade story is also a"},{"start":224.09,"end":225.24,"text":"market story."},{"start":225.27,"end":227.59,"text":"When resilience becomes a budget line, it"},{"start":227.62,"end":229.51,"text":"changes earnings, inflation, and"},{"start":229.58,"end":230.91,"text":"investment decisions."},{"start":230.99,"end":232.76,"text":"The cheapest supplier is no longer"},{"start":232.76,"end":234.16,"text":"automatically the winner."},{"start":234.25,"end":235.86,"text":"The trusted supplier is."},{"start":235.89,"end":237.66,"text":"So let us be precise about what is really"},{"start":237.7,"end":240.16,"text":"happening because the language gets muddy."},{"start":240.19,"end":241.62,"text":"This is not decoupling."},{"start":241.65,"end":244.14,"text":"Total trade between major economies is not"},{"start":244.14,"end":245.05,"text":"collapsing."},{"start":245.13,"end":247.1,"text":"The United States and China still trade"},{"start":247.1,"end":248.98,"text":"enormous volumes with each other."},{"start":249.01,"end":251.26,"text":"Global flows keep setting records."},{"start":251.29,"end":253.52,"text":"What is changing is the geometry."},{"start":253.55,"end":255.38,"text":"Goods are taking longer routes."},{"start":255.41,"end":257.02,"text":"Suppliers are multiplying."},{"start":257.05,"end":259.14,"text":"Inventories are being held higher, closer"},{"start":259.14,"end":261.06,"text":"to home, in more countries."},{"start":261.09,"end":262.85,"text":"Governments are building factories they"},{"start":262.85,"end":264.18,"text":"used to import from."},{"start":264.21,"end":267.13,"text":"The World Bank, the IMF, and the WTO all"},{"start":267.13,"end":268.7,"text":"point the same direction."},{"start":268.73,"end":270.49,"text":"Trade is fragmenting into blocks that"},{"start":270.52,"end":272.25,"text":"trade more with friends and less with"},{"start":272.25,"end":273.26,"text":"everyone else."},{"start":273.29,"end":275.29,"text":"The practical consequence is a quieter,"},{"start":275.37,"end":277.54,"text":"slower, more expensive world."},{"start":277.57,"end":279.57,"text":"One where the same goods move, but with"},{"start":279.64,"end":281.63,"text":"more paperwork, more distance, and more"},{"start":281.63,"end":282.62,"text":"risk priced in."},{"start":282.65,"end":284.92,"text":"Here is the honest uncertainty, stated"},{"start":284.92,"end":285.66,"text":"plainly."},{"start":285.69,"end":288.22,"text":"Nobody knows how far this rerouting goes."},{"start":288.25,"end":290.18,"text":"It is possible that tariffs come down,"},{"start":290.21,"end":292.74,"text":"negotiations succeed, and much of the old"},{"start":292.74,"end":293.9,"text":"system survives."},{"start":293.93,"end":295.54,"text":"It is also possible that the blocks"},{"start":295.54,"end":297.98,"text":"harden, that trust keeps falling, and that"},{"start":298.02,"end":300.4,"text":"trade keeps growing only inside smaller,"},{"start":300.47,"end":301.59,"text":"safer circles."},{"start":301.63,"end":303.87,"text":"The signal to watch is not the headline"},{"start":303.87,"end":304.34,"text":"number."},{"start":304.37,"end":306.37,"text":"It is the behavior underneath it."},{"start":306.41,"end":308.14,"text":"Watch whether companies keep building"},{"start":308.14,"end":309.95,"text":"factories in new countries, or start"},{"start":310.27,"end":311.02,"text":"reversing."},{"start":311.05,"end":313.52,"text":"Watch whether trade agreements multiply or"},{"start":313.52,"end":314.1,"text":"stall."},{"start":314.13,"end":315.7,"text":"Watch whether the share of trade on most"},{"start":315.7,"end":317.91,"text":"favored nation terms keeps falling or"},{"start":317.91,"end":318.98,"text":"stabilizes."},{"start":319.01,"end":320.66,"text":"The map is the story now."},{"start":320.69,"end":322.44,"text":"Not how much the world trades, but who"},{"start":322.44,"end":324.55,"text":"trades with whom, along which routes under"},{"start":324.87,"end":325.56,"text":"which rules."},{"start":325.59,"end":327.82,"text":"Trade can grow and trust can fall at the"},{"start":327.82,"end":329.99,"text":"same time, and that is exactly what the"},{"start":329.99,"end":331.57,"text":"record year is telling us."},{"start":331.61,"end":333.22,"text":"The volume is real."},{"start":333.25,"end":334.84,"text":"The trust is the part still being"},{"start":334.84,"end":335.82,"text":"renegotiated."},{"start":335.85,"end":338.07,"text":"That is the market question for the next"},{"start":338.07,"end":339.99,"text":"phase of the global economy."},{"start":340.03,"end":342.19,"text":"Not whether the world keeps trading, but"},{"start":342.19,"end":344.05,"text":"whether it can learn to trust again while"},{"start":344.17,"end":344.66,"text":"it does."}]
